metadata.description: Open-source design skills for Claude Code, Claude.ai and other agents that support SKILL.md: build a design system, and design pages that don't look AI-made.

plugins.name: design-system-builder
plugins.description: Build, use or update a design system shaped by attached inspiration (images, URLs, brand docs); outputs DESIGN.md plus linked HTML, and builds new UI that follows an existing DESIGN.md.

plugins.name: slopless
plugins.description: Design or redesign websites, landing pages, dashboards and portfolios with a designer's judgment: frames the audience, invents a fitting style, sets exact values for all 8 design settings, then screenshots, audits and fixes the result, flagging AI tells.
